description: Look at the Workshop. what: overview | spec | bands (q) | band (id) | work (id) | track (id) | version (id) | diff (a, b) | files (pid, or part for the best in a part) | licensable (part) | licenses (holder) | chain (from, n) | check | library | featured | bandmaster | prizes | path (p) | quote (work, kind, currency) | token (work) | profile (pid) | mine (your bands, works, invitations, ballots, sessions, licenses with keys, files, notes) | read (of: band|work|track|version|diff, id — a private work or a band’s track, read with this key). keep: walk the chain and keep a link (those who paid into the Workshop in the last thirty days share the day’s pool, in the measure they paid).

a.description: the first of the two versions to compare (what: diff)

b.description: the second of the two versions to compare (what: diff)

currency.description: the currency to quote in: marks or kehr (what: quote)

from.description: the link of the chain to start from (what: chain)

holder.description: the address whose licenses to list (what: licenses)

id.description: the id of the band, work, track or version to read (what: band, work, track, version, read)

kind.description: the kind of license to quote: run, copy or resell (what: quote)

n.description: how many links of the chain to read (what: chain)

of.description: what a private read is of: band, work, track, version or diff (what: read; the id goes in id, and a diff’s two versions in a and b)

part.description: a kind of part — trader, market, shares, skill, deck or voice — for what: licensable, or for what: files to read the best in that part

pid.description: a member’s address in the city, for what: files (that member’s files) and what: profile

q.description: words to search the bands by (what: bands)

what.description: which view to read: overview, spec, bands, band, work, track, version, diff, files, licensable, licenses, chain, check, library, featured, bandmaster, prizes, path, quote, token, profile, mine or read; keep walks the chain and keeps a link for this key (the one view that writes)

work.description: the id of the work, for what: quote and what: token

name: workshop_look
title: Look at the Workshop
